3.name: Great Old One Spells
3.notes:
You always have the following spells prepared at the listed Warlock levels:

3rd: Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Phantasmal Force, Tasha's Hideous Laughter
5th: Clairvoyance, Hunger of Hadar
7th: Confusion, Summon Aberration
9th: Modify Memory, Telekinesis

3.name: Awakened Mind
3.notes:
As a Bonus Action, choose one creature you can see within 30 feet. You and the creature can communicate telepathically while within a number of miles equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). Both must mentally use a language the other knows.

The link lasts minutes equal to your Warlock level and ends early if you create a connection with another creature.

3.name: Psychic Spells
3.notes:
When you cast a Warlock spell that deals damage, you may change its damage type to Psychic.

Additionally, when you cast a Warlock spell that is an Enchantment or Illusion, you can do so without Verbal or Somatic components.

6.name: Clairvoyant Combatant
6.notes:
When you form a telepathic bond using Awakened Mind, you may force the creature to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = your spell save DC). On a failed save:
- The creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
- You have Advantage on attack rolls against that creature.

This lasts for the duration of the telepathic bond.

Recharge: Short or Long Rest, or expend a Pact Magic spell slot to restore use.

10.name: Eldritch Hex
10.notes:
You always have the Hex spell prepared.

When you cast Hex and choose an ability, the target also has Disadvantage on *saving throws* of that ability for the duration.

10.name: Thought Shield
10.notes:
Your thoughts cannot be read by telepathy or similar effects unless you allow it.

You also gain:
- Resistance to Psychic damage.
- Whenever a creature deals Psychic damage to you, it takes the same amount of Psychic damage.

14.name: Create Thrall
14.notes:
When you cast *Summon Aberration*, you can modify it:
- The spell requires no Concentration.
- Duration becomes 1 minute.
- The Aberration gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Warlock level + your Charisma modifier.

Additionally, once per turn, when the Aberration hits a creature affected by your Hex, it deals extra Psychic damage equal to Hex's bonus damage.
